paragraphs: Sanhedrin 17b says that they are Rabbah and Rav Yosef.[^1]

notes.text: The saved Davidson Sanhedrin17b scalar identifies the Amoraim of Pumbedita as Rabbah and Rav Yosef. Rav is explicit before Yosef; Rabbah is a name, not an added rank. Initial separated ב means in, not a numeral or transcription repair.
